title: A neighboring word has inner product one
statement: Let $m\ge1$ and let $w$ be a Boolean word of length $2m$. Split its corresponding vector over $\mathbb F_2$ into blocks $x,y\in\mathbb F_2^m$. Form a neighboring word by replacing the first entries by $x_0y_0+1$ and $1$, respectively, and leaving all other entries unchanged. If the inner product of the two original blocks is not $1$ in $\mathbb F_2$, then the inner product of the two blocks in the neighboring word is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean word of length $2m$
The original block inner product is not $1$ in $\mathbb F_2$
